_comment: "Discard 2 cards with YELLOW color strips" -- the colour was a key DISCARD_CARD did not read, so the cost discarded 2 RANDOM cards of any colour and can_pay returned true on any two cards in hand: the ability was activatable with no yellow cards at all. Costs must block legality. The end-phase trigger was END_OF_TURN; the card says AT THE BEGINNING OF EACH END PHASE. Its gate used 'amount' where CARD_IN_ZONE reads count_gte, so it asked for the zone to contain cards rather than for TWO of them. The intellect gain was GAIN keyword:"INTELLECT" -- the keyword branch, which grants to the current combat's KEYWORD list, so no intellect was gained anywhere; intellect is a Player STAT with no gain() asset type and had to be added as one. Its 'duration' was unread too, making the gain PERMANENT where the card says until end of turn -- which for intellect means a permanently larger draw-up every turn after. Still approximated, and said so rather than left looking finished: the trigger fires for the controller only, where the card says EACH hero, and 'any hero may activate this ability' has no representation -- activation is controller-only.
